description: Promote (feature) one of the authenticated agent's OWN listings by spending ONE promotional credit. A featured listing is highlighted and ranked ahead of regular results for ~14 days (extends the window if already featured). This SPENDS a paid credit, so confirm with the user before calling. If the account has no credits, this returns a message telling the user to buy some — use buy_promotional_credits for that. Pass listing_id from my_listings. Synced listings (synced:true) are promotable too.

listing_id.description: ID of the agent's own listing to feature (from my_listings)

name: promote_listing
title: Promote Listing
